newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup hires Margo Lowry from Kraft.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup hires Margo Lowry from Kraft.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Thursday it hired Margo Lowry as vice president of its new product development-U.S. grocery division.
Lowry most recently directed new business development for the Post Cereal division of Kraft Foods Inc, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc.
Campbell said in a news release that hiring Lowry was part of its accelerated drive for product innovation.
At Kraft, Lowry led Post's launch of Post Waffle Crisp, Banana Nut Crunch, Great Grains and Cranberry Almond Crunch cereals.
Besides soup, Campbell makes Prego pasta sauces, V8 juices, Pace Mexican sauces and other products.
